title:
From report chasing
to numbers you can trust.
body: A working synthetic prototype connects collection, verification and leadership visibility.
notes: Open with the operational problem, not a feature list. This is a simulated portal and fictional data, not a live Upright integration.

title:
Visibility starts
with getting the data.
body: Amanda retrieves and consolidates recurring reports. Debie needs dependable numbers for decisions. Manual handoffs sit between them.

cards.title: Repeated retrieval
cards.text: The same reports, different dates. Portal exports and spreadsheet handoffs.

cards.title: Trust before speed
cards.text: Overlapping sources, refunds, missing fields and stale periods need controls.

cards.title: Decisions downstream
cards.text: A dashboard helps only when the data behind it can be explained.

notes: Interview estimates describe the pain. We have not measured hours saved or promised production performance.

title:
One connected workflow.
Three clear layers.
body: Acquire a report. Verify the exact file. Make the published result accessible.

title:
Keep the proof
beside the answer.
body: Displayed metric run → supporting row → original source fields → exact CSV checksum and import batch.
source: APP-03 · unchanged source bytes and pinned evidence
notes: The displayed result and evidence share the selected run and date/source scope. The UI does not recalculate revenue or substitute mock values.

title:
Test the behavior,
not just the happy path.
body: Browser acceptance uses Jack mc’s handwritten ledger and a separate raw-CSV reader for acquired files.

cards.title: $10.01 → $10.01
cards.text: An identical upload does not double the ledger.

cards.title: $15.76 → $14.76
cards.text: A correction changes publication only after explicit approval.
All ledger rows / unknown-store rows. Missing source data stays unavailable.

notes: These are independent expected amounts, not values copied from the metric API. Existing backend mutation tests and new browser assertions exercise the control rules.

title:

title:
